script_text: Stop scrolling! This week, Taurus, the cosmos serves you a steady rhythm with punchy sparks. Monday, Mercury trine Jupiter gifts clear talk and lucky deals—seal contracts, share ideas fast. Tuesday, Venus squares Saturn; emotions feel heavy, so pause before commitments, choose patience over pressure. Wednesday, Mars lights your tenth house; take decisive steps at work, ask for that raise or pitch boldly. Thursday, the Moon enters your sector of dreams; set aside quiet time for reflection, journal a vision. Friday, Uranus trines your ruling planet; surprise opportunities arrive—stay open, try something new. Saturday, Neptune opposes your chart; avoid overspending, stick to budget, focus on health routines. Sunday, the Sun aligns with your core; celebrate small wins, recharge, and plan next week’s grind. Embrace action on Monday and Wednesday, avoid rash moves on Tuesday and Saturday. Let the stars guide your steps! Stay grounded, thrive soon.
title: Taurus Weekly Forecast
